note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

parser.reason: TypeScript: ts/src/ini.ts imports `Tabnas`, `RuleSpec`, `AltSpec`, `Lex`, `makePoint`, `Token`, `Tin` and `util` from '@tabnas/parser' in a plain import, not `import type`; three are used as values in the `Ini` plugin (`new Tabnas().use(jsonic).parse(grammarText)`, `makePoint(...)`, `util.deep(...)`) and the other five only as types, and ts/package.json declares the engine as a peer. Rust: rs/src/lib.rs uses the `tabnas` crate directly (`Tabnas`, `Plugin`, `Rule`, `RuleState`, `Lexer`, `ImperativeLexMatcher`, `GrammarSpec`, `Value`) and re-exports `TabnasError` as `IniError`, so rs/Cargo.toml lists `tabnas-parser` under [dependencies]. Go: the only tabnas modules that go/ini.go imports are github.com/tabnas/jsonic/go and github.com/tabnas/hoover/go, and it takes every engine name from the aliases in jsonic's engine.go (`jsonic.Jsonic` is `tabnas.Tabnas`; also `jsonic.Rule`, `jsonic.Context`, `jsonic.Lex`, `jsonic.LexCheckResult`, `jsonic.Token`, `jsonic.Deep`); go/clib/core.go imports no tabnas module but the ini package itself, no .go file under go/ imports github.com/tabnas/parser/go, go/go.mod lists the engine as `// indirect`, so it is still built in, through jsonic and through hoover (whose own go/hoover.go imports github.com/tabnas/parser/go directly), and AGENTS.md ("The tabnas engine dependency") documents the arrangement.
parser.repair: Either the Go port imports the engine: go/ini.go would import github.com/tabnas/parser/go for the names it now takes from the jsonic aliases, and go/go.mod would require it directly instead of `// indirect`. Or the TypeScript and Rust ports take the engine through jsonic as Go does: ts/src/ini.ts would import from '@tabnas/jsonic', which re-exports `Tabnas`, `makePoint`, `util` and the engine types, and ts/package.json would drop the @tabnas/parser peer; rs/Cargo.toml cannot drop `tabnas` until tabnas-jsonic re-exports the engine: today its rs/src/lib.rs re-exports only `TabnasError`, as `JsonicError`. Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
